title: Selected creative, daily delivery
description: Daily spend, impressions, clicks, installs, trial starts and purchases for the Meta ad IDs of the selected roadmap row.

args.query:
SELECT date, country AS market, ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS spend, SUM(impressions) AS impressions, SUM(clicks) AS clicks, SUM(installs) AS installs, SUM(checkouts_initiated) AS checkouts, SUM(trial_starts) AS trial_starts, SUM(initial_purchases) AS purchases
FROM `speak-v2-2a1f1.analytics.meta_ads_creative_report_funnel`
WHERE '{{ad_ids}}' <> '' AND ad_id IN UNNEST(SPLIT('{{ad_ids}}', ',')) AND country IN ('Taiwan', 'Hong Kong') AND spend > 0
GROUP BY date, country
ORDER BY date, country
